title: l: A new runtime for k and q
summary: L is a new runtime implementation for the K and Q programming languages (associated with KDB+), which are powerful array languages commonly used for financial data processing and time-series analytics. The project aims to provide better performance, improved developer experience, and modern tooling for the kdb+/q ecosystem.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative runtime for K/Q that may offer better performance, cross-platform compatibility, and modern development workflows compared to the traditional kdb+ implementation.
why_valuable: K and Q are notoriously difficult to learn and deploy; a modern runtime could lower barriers to entry and enable more developers to leverage the powerful array processing capabilities of these languages.
